newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Playboy FY97 EPS view raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Playboy FY97 EPS view raised.

text.p: --Gruntal & Co said Thursday it increased its FY97 earnings per share estimate on Playboy Enterprises Inc to $0.40 from $0.38. It lowered its FY98 estimate to $0.54 from $0.58.
--Gruntal said the changes account for implementation of Section 505 of the Telecommunications Act, which takes effect in mid-May and concerns the effects of scrambling equipment.
--Gruntal also reiterated its $24 per share 12-month price target on the publishing and entertainment company's stock.
